import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def modinv(x):
    return pow(x, MOD-2, MOD)

INV100 = modinv(100)

def po(x):
    return 1 << x

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    p = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            val = int(next(it))
            p[i][j] = (val * INV100) % MOD

    no = [0]*n
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(1<<n):
            if not ((j >> i) & 1):
                no[i] |= po(j)

    m = {1: 1}
    for i in range(n):
        M = {}
        for t_mask, t_prob in m.items():
            for j in range(1<<n):
                res = 0
                prob = 1
                for k in range(n):
                    if (j >> k) & 1:
                        prob = (prob * p[i][k]) % MOD
                        res |= ((t_mask & no[k]) << (1 << k))
                    else:
                        prob = (prob * (1 - p[i][k])) % MOD
                key = res
                M[key] = (M.get(key, 0) + t_prob * prob) % MOD
        m = M

    ans = m.get(po((1<<n)-1), 0)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
